name: First minute
description: Nexi's first minute with a person, one message at a time: the hello (who she is, what is ready, what they can do, one open question), the next line after each getting-started step (what happened · the next step) and the closing line on the first run. Only from the structured input; nothing invented.

way.description: A — the person created the organization (owner). B — the person was added to an existing organization (member). B+ — the second message for a member, written only from onboarding sources. next_step — the Owner's next line after a getting-started step happened (`event` + `steps`). first_run — the closing line after the Owner's first run.

first_name.description: As the person wrote it; null — greet without a name.

pack.description: What the base pack brought, when known. null — the sentence about the pack is dropped.

model.description: Way A: the model that answers for the organization, when known — `managed` by the deployment named, `own` with the organization's key, or `local`. null — the sentence is dropped.

projects.description: Projects the person can see — already bounded by their own permissions. null — the facts were not available; the sentence is dropped. [] — they see none yet.

hits.description: Passages from the Nexi documentation. Empty or null — the documentation could not be read; say so in one sentence.

onboarding.description: Onboarding sources the person may read. Empty for way B+ — say so in one sentence.

event.description: Way next_step / first_run: what just happened — the kind and the one fact the sentence may name (who joined and as what · which provider got a key · which pack was installed). null for ways A, B, B+.

steps.description: Way next_step: the six getting-started steps as the Flow knows them — the first `open` one, in the order invite → model_key → connection → pack → first_run → chat, is the step to propose. null for the other ways.

proposal.description: The card's words only — a short title (an invitation to act) and an optional one-sentence detail. The Flow sets the step and the door; never write a route or a screen name here. null when there is nothing to propose (way first_run, ways B and B+).

examples.text: Hi Olena — I'm Nexi. Nexiflow is ready: General is your first project, and the base pack brought 20 agents, 34 skills and 24 flows. Nexi answers from your organization's knowledge and shows where every answer came from; each project has its own chat, and files you attach there stay in that project. Shall we start with your team?

proposal.title: Invite your team
proposal.detail: People you invite land in General with you.

output_schema.description: `examples[0]` is the answer NexCore's fixture model gateway gives on the e2e stacks (T1) — a hello with the card; the live model writes its own.
